hook.say: The ten busiest airports on Earth, ranked. Four of them are in the United States!

outro.say: Which ones have you flown through? Comment below!

items.name: Denver
items.say: Number ten: Denver, America's largest airport by area. Eighty-two-point-four million passengers.
items.cap: Number ten: Denver, America's largest airport by area. 82.4 million passengers.

items.name: Guangzhou
items.say: Nine: Gwahng-joe, the gateway to southern China. Eighty-three-point-six million passengers.
items.cap: Nine: Guangzhou, the gateway to southern China. 83.6 million passengers.

items.name: Istanbul
items.say: Eight: Istanbul, opened just eight years ago. Eighty-four-point-four million passengers.
items.cap: Eight: Istanbul, opened just eight years ago. 84.4 million passengers.

items.name: London Heathrow
items.say: Seven: London Heathrow, the busiest in Europe. Eighty-four-point-five million passengers.
items.cap: Seven: London Heathrow, the busiest in Europe. 84.5 million passengers.

items.name: Chicago O'Hare
items.say: Six: Chicago O'Hare, number one for takeoffs and landings. Eighty-four-point-nine million passengers.
items.cap: Six: Chicago O'Hare, number one for takeoffs and landings. 84.9 million passengers.

items.name: Shanghai Pudong
items.say: Five: Shanghai Poo-dong, up from tenth place. Eighty-five-point-zero million passengers.
items.cap: Five: Shanghai Pudong, up from tenth place. 85.0 million passengers.

items.name: Dallas Fort Worth
items.say: Four: Dallas Fort Worth, bigger than Manhattan. Eighty-five-point-seven million passengers.
items.cap: Four: Dallas Fort Worth, bigger than Manhattan. 85.7 million passengers.

items.name: Tokyo Haneda
items.say: Three: Tokyo Haneda, minutes from central Tokyo. Ninety-one-point-seven million passengers.
items.cap: Three: Tokyo Haneda, minutes from central Tokyo. 91.7 million passengers.

items.name: Dubai
items.say: Two: Dubai, number one for international travel. Ninety-five-point-two million passengers.
items.cap: Two: Dubai, number one for international travel. 95.2 million passengers.

items.name: Atlanta
items.say: And number one: Atlanta! 106 million passengers, the busiest for decades.
items.cap: And number one: Atlanta! 106 million passengers, the busiest for decades.
